name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Lifecycle: /spec:genesis (greenfield) → roadmap briefs → /spec:mocks → /spec:plan → /spec:run (build, then review, each driver-stepped with one fresh-context reviewer and a derived verdict) → /spec:release; plus /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:fix. Changelog (last 3): 7.266.0 — The escape command is deleted: a fix commit touching lines a reviewed spec landed records the escape row itself through /git:commit step 3 (one row per commit, class the only question), the escape row loses six derived fields, a red CI observation surfaces as a /spec:fix entry, and the review driver's done-spec refusal names /spec:fix; hosts re-stamp with /spec:doctor. 7.265.0 — Review close refuses any drift between the committed close tree and the judged tree, every time; softs are advisory debt written with the CLOSE verdict or ride a fix round the reviewer re-checks, and the post-verdict fix window, its line ceiling and its sweep mark are gone. 7.264.0 — The prototype's contracted mark records what the rounds left behind: --mark opened stores the base commit, --mark contracted stamps the brief's Prototype: line (the design prose below it is historical, contract.json is current) and writes a reconcile block into contract.json listing every docs/adr and docs/roadmap file committed since opening plus every stray file in the prototype folder; the CONTRACTED step prints both lists and names the stamped brief to commit, and /spec:plan's contract entry turns each listed ADR into a Decisions row (the pin that outranks it, or superseded). The picture command's {url}/{out}/{width}/{height} placeholders are substituted as quoted variable references (PROTO_PICTURE_*), so a state url carrying & reaches the host command whole instead of backgrounding it. The comment-sweep certificate test now judges the sweep commit against its parent instead of the working tree against main, which went red on every later script change.
